families.prompt: Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Weak fine irregular bright and dark pixel fluctuations, uniform neutral field, no scene or objects.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Fine irregular bright and dark fluctuations with short range spatial correlation and uneven local strength, no coherent objects or repeating patterns.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Irregular narrow vertical bright and dark column bands with unequal widths and varying intensity along columns, no scene.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Sparse finite straight vertical bright and dark column streaks with distinct endpoints and uneven lengths, neutral background, no objects.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Irregular narrow horizontal bright and dark row bands, unequal widths, intensity varies along each row, no scene.
Flat grayscale infrared detector offset residual. Soft irregular smoothly varying brightness without sharp boundaries, neutral field, no objects or scene.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual map. Fine irregular bright and dark grains mixed with thin uneven vertical column bands, varying local strength, no objects or repeated grid.
Flat grayscale infrared detector residual. Fine irregular bright and dark pixel fluctuations with noisy and quiet regions, slowly varying local strength, no edges or coherent shapes.

ir.parameter_status: Morphology-informed engineering ranges, not sensor calibration or dataset-wide noise fit.

families.prompt: Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Thin irregular horizontal bright and dark scan lines, nonperiodic row offsets and varying intensity along each line, no atoms or lattice.
Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Horizontal bright and dark scan bands with uneven narrow widths, irregular spacing and varying intensity along each row, no sample structure.

Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Sparse isolated thin horizontal bright and dark short scan streaks with distinct local endpoints, irregular positions and lengths, neutral background, no atoms.
Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Isolated short horizontal bright and dark scan streaks of mixed thin widths and finite lengths, irregular sparse groups and quiet gaps, no objects.
Flat grayscale STM electronic residual. Fine irregular bright and dark pixel fluctuations over a neutral field, no atoms, lattice, rings or sample structure.
Flat grayscale STM electronic residual. Fine irregular bright and dark fluctuations with short range spatial correlation, uneven local strength, no atoms, lattice, rings or coherent objects.
Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Fine irregular bright and dark grain mixed with sparse thin short horizontal scan streaks, distinct endpoints, no lattice or sample structures.
Flat grayscale STM acquisition residual. Fine irregular bright and dark grain mixed with thin nonperiodic horizontal scan bands, varying intensity along lines, no atoms or lattice.
